Type: deco
Name: Amazon Brand - Rivet Modern Tall Geometric Wire Baskets, Set of 2, 13.25"H and 10.75"H, Gold
Colors: Gold
These matching wire baskets are just the thing you've been looking for to bring a sense of functionality and modern art to your living space. Breathtaking empty or in use, they are the perfect modern addition to any room in your home. Large: 13.25"H x 17.75" diameter; small: 10.75"H x 13.25" diameter Formed of metal wire Useful for storing small items This stunning work of craftsmanship showcases the perfect marriage of functionality and grace. Avoid moisture and wipe clean with a soft, dry cloth.
